correctness.rationale: For synchronous threshold-one 3-state Greenberg–Hastings dynamics on connected Q_d (d≥1), a period-three trajectory either rotates all vertices through 0→1→2 or is all-zero fixed: any persistently resting zero adjacent to a rotating vertex would be excited, and connectivity propagates this. Thus primitive immediate period three is equivalent to X=0 defects, where each Y_v indicates no neighbor with color C_v+1. Conditioning on initial color gives p=(2/3)^d; two centers at distance one have joint probability (3/4)p², distance two (9/8)p², and distance at least three independent because closed one-neighborhoods are disjoint. Summing covariances across d+binom(d,2) neighbors gives Var X=µ+Np²(d²−5d−16)/16, µ=(4/3)^d, switching sign precisely between d7 and d8. Dependence ball at Hamming distance ≤2 has M_d=1+d+C(d,2); Arratia–Goldstein–Gordon 1989 Theorem1 with its norm 2TV and b1=N M_d p²,b2=Np²(3d/4+9C(d,2)/8),b3=0 gives standard count TV ≤pB_d(1−e^{-µ}); Theorem3 gives vector-TV ≤2Np²(B_d+1). These tend to zero since Np²=(8/9)^d. Greedy packing of disjoint closed neighborhoods selects at least ceil(N/M_d) independent defect indicators and bounds P(X=0)≤(1−p)^ceil(N/M_d)≤e^{-µ/M_d}→0. Independent reimplementation enumerated all 9,81,6561 initial configurations for d=1,2,3 obtaining (waves,E,Var) respectively (0,4/3,2/9),(0,16/9,56/81),(252,64/27,1024/729), agreeing with published formula. Frozen tools/defect_check.py source checked for direct 3-step dynamics and exact pairs. Finite enumeration is only corroboration of all-d analytic theorem.
